payload.content: Refer to Endocrinology for evaluation and ongoing management of presumed type 2 diabetes mellitus and associated cardiovascular risk factors. Patient is a male aged 35–49 currently taking metformin 500 mg and lisinopril 10 mg daily. Please assess glycemic control, review renal function and urine albumin screening, evaluate for diabetes-related complications, and provide recommendations regarding medication optimization, blood pressure targets, and preventive care. Include recent HbA1c, fasting glucose, renal function, urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio, lipid profile, blood pressure readings, and relevant medical history with the referral.
